classes.label: Ambiguous
classes.description: several listed entities share the form; the reported id is undecided

classes.label: Suspicion signal
classes.description: a deterministic warning fired: homograph, compound, citation frame or container

classes.label: Unanchored surname
classes.description: a bare surname without a full-name anchor in the document

classes.label: Running head
classes.description: repeated page furniture; outside the marking scope by convention (E105)

classes.label: Citation context
classes.description: inside a plain bibl element; identity needs the citation read

classes.label: Derived spelling
classes.description: a spelling derived from a listed form (initials, acronym case, subtitle join, legacy)

classes.label: Markup boundary
classes.description: the match crosses markup and is reported truncated

classes.label: Short work title
classes.description: a one-word title; typography has to corroborate the reading
